I'll start by reading TASK.md and brief.md so I can follow the brief exactly, with section 0 taking priority.Section 0 says to read the T9c decision, both Sol reviews, and the T9c run outputs before any experiment. I'll load those next.T9c closed partial: size and kind never came from the site that was patched, and profile B drew no marks. I'll read the T9c runners and display notes so the six-version limit is spent on the right experiments.The size path is in the frame writer: the mode word picks fixed constants, or a pair of setting calls for the custom modes. I'll locate those sites, then run the one stock sweep that has to record every getter in that window.The sweep is in. Small draws 19×21 marks and Single draws 8×9, so Single is a visible second size. Next I’ll read which getter calls actually set that mode.The writer reads the mode word already stored at object+`0x374`, and the only settings getter inside that window is the shared call at `0x6041a1fb`. Single is the second visible size: 8×9 marks against Small’s 19×21. I’ll lock those reference frames, then run the hooked sessions.All four validation runs finished with `ok:true`. Next I’ll pull the per-edge records and the T9c record format so the report matches the brief.The validation sessions all ended `ok:true`. I’ll check the listings against the image and pull the per-edge numbers before writing the records.Listings match the image, and the overlay touches only the three allowed bytes in section 7. I’ll write the display note and the result from those records.The display hook now takes the AF-ON size from the mirror, and both seeded profiles match a measured reference frame.

While the owner is 2, `0x6041935b` returns the saved-bank position and zone, and `0x6041a1fb` returns the `0x1dd1` size bytes. The kind branch is gone: that key never appears in the writer window. Profile A is Small, four 19×21 marks. Profile B is Single at the same non-centre position, four 8×9 marks.

Five emulator versions ran, under the limit of six. Full K2, seeded A, seeded B, and stock K1 each ended `ok:true` across 12 edges. On A and B every branch substituted at least once (position 16, zone 16, size 6). K2, unseeded, substituted nothing. Frame changes landed inside 599.60794 ms, and edges whose reference frame stays the same held still through that window.

`work/result.md` and `work/evidence-manifest.json` are in place. The manifest includes the three T6 baseline files, and `work/out/seal-t9d.json` seals the records.
